That spirit of innovation and excellence drives everything we do – from our state-of-the-art emergency medical services program, to our new and expanding graduate medical education programs, to our progressive care models that focus on preventive care. These are just some of the ways we go above and beyond to help the communities we serve. To stay up to date on all things Geisinger Emergency Medicine, connect with us on LinkedIn Our Teams Advanced Practice Providers A vital part of our care team, Geisinger’s Emergency Medicine APPs can expect the best development resources and training to thrive in their role. Geisinger’s Department of Advanced Practice Providers serves to support our Advanced Practitioners and Advanced Practitioner students through interdepartmental consultation, benchmarking of best practices, professional practice standards, compensation, personnel management, and care delivery models. In addition to a comprehensive range of benefits, candidates also receive a $20k recruitment incentive to join our team. Pediatric Emergency Medicine Our team is bringing top-notch Pediatric Emergency Medicine to rural communities across central Pennsylvania through an innovative approach to pediatric readiness. Our regional strategy leverages Pediatric Emergency Medicine specialist knowledge and skills to support our outstanding Emergency Medicine colleagues in caring for children across our 10-hospital system. We use telemedicine, clinical guideline development with electronic health record integration, pediatric equipment standardization, clinical tool development, education and simulation initiatives, participation in national collaboratives, local and regional quality improvement, an amazing system Pediatric Emergency Care Coordinator, and a regional, multidisciplinary Pediatric Emergency Care Coordinator (PECC) council to help deliver high quality care at diverse emergency departments across a large geographic distribution. Central to the coordination of pediatric emergency care within our system is the colorful, 9-bed “Peds Zone” in the Emergency Department at the Janet Weis Children’s Hospital at Geisinger Medical Center ( Pediatric Emergency Room | Geisinger ) in Danville, PA. The “Peds Zone” will be expanding to a 14-bed unit in the next few years with the completion of a critical care tower expansion project ( GMC Expansion | Geisinger | News Release ). The Janet Weis Children’s Hospital ( Janet Weis Children’s Hospital & CHOP | Geisinger ) at Geisinger Medical Center is a 90-bed children’s hospital with a 14-bed PICU and 41-bed NICU that provides a comprehensive range of pediatric services including a full array of medical and surgical pediatric subspecialties. We are also establishing a second hub for Pediatric Emergency Medicine at the Geisinger Wyoming Valley Hospital Emergency Department in Wilkes-Barre, PA. In addition to providing outstanding bedside care and coordinating pediatric emergency care throughout our system, our team is very involved in resident education, national collaboratives, and research. We work closely as faculty to teach and mentor Pediatrics , Med/Peds Emergency Medicine Residents , and medical students through the Geisinger Commonwealth Medical School (Geisinger College of Health Sciences). Recent Geisinger PEM faculty accomplishments include: EMSC Scholars appointment ( Meet the 2022 EMSC Scholars - EIIC ) EMSC Fellowship appointment ( Steve "Jason" Crellin, DO - EIIC 2024 Amanda Wertz Memorial Emergency Medical Services for Children Award ( Geisinger pediatric emergency medicine physician receives award Pediatric Sepsis Emergency Criteria Expert Panel Membership Geisinger Academy of Educators Distinguished membership ( Academy of Educators | Geisinger College of Health Sciences GCSOM Medical Student Summer Research Immersion Program mentorship ( Summer Research Immersion Program | Geisinger Commonwealth Academic presentations at Pediatric Academic Society, Pennsylvania ACEP, The American Medical Informatics Association Journal Publications through the American Journal of Emergency Medicine, Pediatrics Textbook chapter authorship in Fleischer Ludwig and Pediatric Critical Care Study Guide Ultrasound Collaboration and knowledge sharing are top-of-mind here. We offer system-wide clinical ultrasound administration opportunities, where everyone can collaborate across departments. There’s also a monthly multidisciplinary image review conference with different departments like Critical Care, Cardiology, and Sports Medicine. Our teams conduct weekly QA of images obtained in the emergency department, used to develop ultrasound quality improvement projects. Other perks include a one-year Accredited Emergency Ultrasound Fellowship within the Emergency Ultrasound Fellowship Accreditation Council, based at GMC (Danville, PA), as well as archiving and quality assurance services. Research Our research team works closely with the EM residency program leadership to improve resident training and foster healthy intellectual dialogue. In 2023, our Emergency Department published 21 peer-reviewed articles and three book chapters/textbooks and presented our work at 70 scientific conferences. System-wide, we had >$57 million in external grant and contract revenue, >1,400 active research projects, including clinical trials, and >1,090 publications. EMS We’re proud of our robust emergency medical services program that includes nine state-of-the-art Geisinger Life Flight® helicopters stationed at six bases and two Critical Care Ground Transports. Education At Geisinger, ‘learning’ is one of our core values. Fortunately, our environment is uniquely suited, with diverse pathologies, patient populations, and acuities, to educate the best and brightest minds in medicine, including Geisinger Commonwealth School of Medicine students and Geisinger Emergency Medicine residents. We are excited to expand our graduate medical education of EM residents with our second EM residency program based at Geisinger Wyoming Valley in Wilkes-Barre, PA (coming in 2026). Our first program , established in 1976 at Geisinger Medical Center in Danville, PA, is one of the oldest of its kind and maintains full accreditation from the ACGME Residency Review Committee. System Triage Officers When our ED patients need expedited transfers within the health system, we rely on our System Triage Officers (STOs) to help make it happen. Geisinger’s STOs are Emergency Medicine physicians who work virtually to ensure proper patient movement throughout the health system. Trauma Our trauma centers provide immediate care for patients with severe or life-threatening injuries. Geisinger Medical Center and Geisinger Wyoming Valley Medical Center are Level 1 trauma centers, equipped to provide the highest level of trauma care to those who are critically ill or injured. To learn more about Geisinger’s extensive trauma services, click here. Emergency medicine physicians at Geisinger have significantly broadened their influence both within and beyond the emergency department by serving in other key leadership and strategic roles, including Hospital Chief Medical Officers, Utilization Management Review, Information Technology, Population Health, Employee Health, Geisinger Health Plan, and various Hospital and System Quality Committees.
